conventions.rounding: floor unless a rule says otherwise
conventions.additive_then_multiplicative: per-point Attribute/Skill bonuses add into one derived multiplier; trait/perk/crit/condition multipliers then multiply (x1.3 with +50% = x1.95)

referees.narrator: owns judgement; where a rule says the Narrator decides, the engine asks and waits

combined_check.mod: lowest skill mod in the check + 2 for each other skill in the check with >= 1 point

skill_track.check_mod: rules 1.13: on a check, an Ask and a passive, a gamma-slot skill adds its full points (points==0 ? -2 : points); alpha and beta skills, and every save, attack, Initiative and debuff TN, use mod_formula

echo.spend: 1 Echo rerolls any d20 you rolled

voices.mode: story beats (out of combat); Overreach pushes in any mode
voices.passive_score: 10 + check_mod(skill) (resolution.skill_track.check_mod: a gamma skill counts its full points)
voices.line_order: largest margin first; ties: narrator choice
voices.lines_written_by: narrator, in the voice card of skills.json

ask_a_skill.vs: lowest-TN unrevealed hook for that skill
ask_a_skill.on_fail: the skill has nothing to say

cores.note: rules 1.13: Body, Mind and Soul are group names (families, colours, saves). Nobody spends Core points; a Core shows the highest attribute of its family.

creation.auto_spend: placing a skill above its attribute spends the Attribute points it needs; blocked if the budget can't cover it
creation.lock_in_requires: all Skill and Attribute points spent
creation.after_creation: a skill can't pass its attribute; Attribute points come from levelling
creation.source: rules 1.13 (Skeleton 2.0): the 2020 budgets of 10 Skill and 10 Attribute points; the 6 Core points are gone
creation.caps: skill <= attribute; an attribute's ceiling is 7 at creation, 8 from level 3, 9 from level 6, 10 from level 9

gains.source: rules revision 1.11 (10 Nov 2026), docs/design/proposals/2026-11-skeleton.md; before it: 1 skill point a level, an attribute point on even levels, a core point every 5th level

extra.legendary_deed: narrator's call: +1 Attribute point, and for each deed one Attribute point may stand 1 above the level's ceiling (never above 10). Rules 1.13, item 1006

derived.note: Attr counts from 1, Skill = points 0-10; floor results; mod(skill) = -2 at 0 points, else points-1 (on a check, an Ask and a passive a gamma skill adds its full points: resolution.skill_track.check_mod)

debuff_strength.rule: max(0, mod(the skill that delivered the condition)): there is no longer one number a family

by_source.technique: the skill the weapon hits with (a technique's own save adds half of it, rounded up)
by_source.call_or_spoken: the gamma skill that spoke (intimidation, eloquence, implication, ...)

debuff_strength.note: before rules 1.13: body from intimidation, brain from eloquence, heart from implication

senses_tiles.call_range: 4 + the points of the Call's gamma skill

multipliers.elemental: 1 (rules 1.26: no Elemental bonus; an aimed action has no slope)
multipliers.sigil: 1.7 x Level.deal (rules 1.26: the aimed profile; output.profiles.sigil)
multipliers.soul: 1.55 x Level.deal (rules 1.26: the aimed profile; output.profiles.soul)
multipliers.healing_given: 1.392 x (1 + 0.06*(insight-1) + 0.06*empathy), never under half of a normal share's (rules 1.27: the landed profile; output.profiles.healing)
multipliers.critical: min(2.0, 1.5 + 0.03*(perception-1) + 0.02*dexterity + perks, traits and gear) (rules 1.15; provisional). An enemy: 1.5

magic.sigil_core_saving: floor(brain_power/3) per spell; spell cost min 1
magic.free_pumps_per_round: 1 from empathy 3 (rules 1.19: one free Pump a turn at most; empathy 7: a swell adds no Strain)

social.karma_bonus_per_award: +authority (Karma moves 1 further a point each time it changes)

classes.note: Class Roster Revision 3. The rule and every number of it (the level a class is earned at, whose class it is, the attribute and the level of each rank, the shelved advanced classes) are written once, in classes.json `assignment`; the engine reads them there (character.ts CLASS_RULES). The Revision 2 numbers once kept here (signature totals 13 and 18, tutors) are retired.

grid.diagonals: melee reach counts diagonals; diagonal movement cost not specified

surprise_round.built_note: not built; see spec item 1501. What the engine does instead: an unaware enemy loses round 1 (Stealth and awareness, item 92), and an ambush from hiding opens on the attacker's own turn with the AP it has left. The spec's surprise round stands until Leon rules.

start: strain -1 (always; rules 1.5), then a held Outburst swells (+1 stage, +1 Strain)
turn.end: unspent AP lost except AP held for Overwatch

opportunity_attack.trigger: enemy leaves your melee reach without Disengage

actions.text: each AP buys your Movement in tiles; a difficult-terrain tile counts double; paid-for tiles not yet walked carry over to the rest of the turn; cost = ceil((tiles - carried) / Movement)
move 3 x Movement tiles
move 1 tile, provokes no opportunity attacks
drop prone or stand up
light melee/unarmed 2 AP; heavy melee 3 AP
single shot or loose an arrow
3 rounds at one target, two rolls; the second roll at -4 to hit (a Quick weapon -3; a Heavy weapon that is braced -1). Rules 1.18

actions.area_built: every enemy ahead of the shooter within 1.5 tiles of the line to the target (a weapon with Wide Spray: its auto_width + 0.5), at any range the weapon reaches. Cone or corridor is open: spec item 1502
actions.text: one roll per target
speed reload: swap in the fullest spare magazine, the old one drops into the pile on your tile; or swap an Evoker core
tactical reload: the old magazine goes back in the pack, rounds still in it
use an item, open a door
draw from the pack into one hand (a one-handed weapon, a focus, a torch, a shield); what the hand held goes to the pack
draw a two-handed weapon: it fills both hands, what the off hand held goes to the pack
swap main hand and off hand
put away what a hand holds into the pack: 1 AP a hand, 2 for a two-handed weapon
drop what a hand holds: it lands in the pile on your tile
put on or take off a light armour piece (1.2 kg or less), each; heavier armour isn't changed in a fight
fit a mod to the main-hand weapon
pick up any or all of the pile on your tile or an adjacent one
reveals HP, armour, resistances, weak points
hold AP for one shot at the first enemy that moves into your line

actions.ap: by the prayer (patrons.json prayer): a Whisper 1, a Hymn 3, a Miracle 3
actions.note: an Atheist prays too, by dice, with no patron (rules 1.6: Atheists and pilgrims)

actions.text: a sentence
persuade, threaten or parley (skill check)
put out Burning

modifiers.recoil: -1 per earlier shot this turn, reduced by floor(dexterity/2)

attack.flanking: cover only counts if the attack line passes through the side of the tile the cover protects

cover.stray_shots: a shot that misses only because of half cover's -5 hits the cover
cover.shoot_cover: weapon attack AP and ammo, no roll, weapon damage

triggers: natural 19-20 on an Aimed shot or an attack from Hidden
critical.damage: x critical multiplier (1.5, to 2.0 at most: rules 1.15), reduced by target crit_damage_taken

armor.other_slots: head, hands, footwear etc. carry per-item effects

weapons_rules.recoil: each shot after the first in a turn -1 cumulative, reduced by floor(dexterity/2)

reloading.magazine: speed reload (cost_ap): swap in the fullest spare magazine; the one in the gun drops into the pile on your tile, empty or with its rounds and ammo type (spec items 679, 680)
reloading.tactical: tactical reload: the speed reload's cost + world_play.json pile.tactical_reload_extra_ap (1); the old magazine goes back to the spares in the pack with its rounds and type; not for a gun loaded round by round (spec item 679)
reloading.full: a magazine gun that is full isn't reloaded (Already full.)
reloading.off_hand: a character's off-hand gun reloads only from its own spares (or, loaded round by round, its loose rounds); an enemy's never runs out until stat blocks list it
reloading.loose: top up from loose rounds; nothing drops
reloading.enemies: carry the spare magazines their tier lists (Enemy stat blocks) and always speed-reload, so their magazines feed the piles (spec item 679)
reloading.pickup: a selection of the entries in the pile on your tile or one adjacent tile, everything by default (world_play.json ap.pickup; spec items 674, 675)

conditions_rules.save: d20 + the target's save for the family (Body: Guts, Brain: Rumination, Heart: Composure) >= 12 + the strength of the skill that delivered the condition (its modifier, never below 0); a technique's own save adds half that strength, rounded up
conditions_rules.stacking: never stacks; reapplication resets to the longer duration

sigil.grammar: rules 1.4: at least 1 Subject and 1 other word; 2-4 glyphs in a straight Line (the only shape); one Reach word per spell; with no Reach word the spell is Touch (1 tile deep); full grammar in sigils.json
sigil.cost: draw: each word's charge + Glyph AP + 1 Flux; evoke: 1 AP + 1 charge per glyph - sigil_core_saving, min 1
sigil.hit: damage spells: brain_power vs defense; Afflictions: the target saves against 12 + the caster's strength with Brain Power; Boons and Workings: no roll
sigil.damage: the strongest damaging Subject in full + half of every other damaging glyph (items 588, 589) x Reach x Burst x Delivery multipliers x 0.9 per repeated glyph x the Line multiplier (rules 1.17: 1.7 for 2 glyphs, 1.75 for 3, 1.8 for 4; a character's Lines only) x (1 + the Sigil bonus + the Elemental bonus for elemental damage: added, not multiplied); a critical x1.5, to x2.0 at most; no ceiling

design.second_school: a rider at half strength with its own option

soul.cost: (school base + modules + 10 if second school + tone cost) * band soul_cost_mult * (1 + soul_cost_pct/100), min 5

strain.decay: -1 at the start of every one of your turns, always
strain.burn: 8 true damage per point over the limit at the end of your turn

mana_short.effect: Stunned 1 turn; a held Outburst goes off wild with its element's stage-1 rider on your own tile; Strain falls to the limit

calming: steady the heart (1 AP, holding) -1 and no swell next turn

soul.hit: damage: Bolt and Lance roll will_power vs defense (a critical x1.5, to x2.0 at most; the roll reads the level gap: rules 1.17); Wave, Burst and Aura don't roll; control/status: saves

cycle.pump_mp: 10% of the Begin's MP * the stage reached (10%, 20%, 30%, 40%), min 1; rules 1.24, provisional (soul_modules.json cycle.pump_mp)
cycle.swell: +1 stage and +1 Strain (+2 Flooded) at each of your turn starts while holding
cycle.note: rules 1.19: x0.8 at stage 0, +0.2 a stage; the Damage base is 40 for a character (36 before Leon's ruling of 12 Nov 2026) and 24 for an enemy caster (soul_modules.json damage); one free Pump a turn; each feeling once in an Outburst

prayer.note: Prayer, Devotion and its XP are in patrons.json (rules 1.6 and 1.6.1: Devotion XP, the tag caps, Whisper / Hymn / Miracle, overreach, Witnessed, vows, rites, leaving a patron). The rules 1.0 numbers once kept here (a level a rite, the patron's mood as a TN) are retired.

level_factor.from: enemies.json levels.table damage_mult, at the caster's level
level_factor.who: characters and the units that fight for them; an enemy caster's healing and shields grow through its own multipliers (rules 1.15)

round_limit.withdrawn: rules 1.23 (Leon, 12 Nov 2026): there is no round limit. Rules 1.20 held spells and prayers to half of a creature's max HP a round; healing is priced in AP now, and the enemies go for whoever mends the most.

medic.note: The medic's kit, each × Healing given × the level factor of the giver's level. Triage: 2 AP, next to you, once an ally a turn, no supplies (out of a fight, with time to work: × triage_out_of_fight_mult, once an ally a scene). A stim and Stim Throw: 1 AP and a dose (a stim, or a Supply). Rally: 2 AP, every ally within 4 tiles, once a scene. A Field Repair on an ally: 2 AP and a spare-parts charge, per point of Improvisation.

tending.note: The enemy AI's healer weight. What a unit has healed and shielded for others over this round and the last is counted; under a tenth of the giver's own max HP it is not noticed. How hard each tier turns on the healer is its healer_focus in enemies.json (0: never; 0.5: the healer counts as hurt by half its max HP more; 1: the healer comes first, and a shooter steps for a line on it).

mending.text: Healing and shields from Sigil magic, Outbursts, prayers and the medic's kit grow with the giver's level, by the same factor that raises what enemies deal (×1.13 at level 6, ×1.38 at level 12, ×1.82 at level 20). Nothing limits how much a creature can be healed in a round. Enemies notice who is mending the squad and turn on them: Soldiers lean that way, Elites and Bosses go for the healer first. In an area shape a healing or shielding Outburst gives each ally ×0.4.

rarity.rules: rules 1.26 (the re-fit): Weapons v2, Rarity, moved from code into data. Rarity buys accuracy, durability and a mod slot; since the re-fit it adds no damage (Masterwork's +10% was the gun premium the all-in ceiling could not hold: PROVISIONAL, spec item 1701)

balance.rules: rules 1.26 (the re-fit, 12 Nov 2026): the balance contract. docs/design/balance-contract.md explains every number; packages/engine/test/balance-contract.test.ts measures each system and fails when it leaves its band.
balance.unit: percent of what the normal-share plain rifle deals in one 6-AP turn on the simulator's range at the same level (a heal: of one Soldier-turn)

tolerance.note: a system's all-in measure, averaged over the levels, is within mean of its ceiling; no single level more than level off (a system with a ladder of its own, Devotion, has its own low end: level_lo)

plain.what: the plain rifle in all-in hands (a normal share is 100 by definition)

gun.what: the best gun, the best way (Masterwork)
gun.dial: rules.json rarity (Masterwork's damage, 1.0 since rules 1.26), then each weapon's damage

melee.what: the heavy-melee damage dealer (the Defender sits lower: its own armour and Guard pay for standing in reach)

sigil_line.what: a full Line (4 glyphs) over the turns it takes to draw

whisper_turn.what: a turn with only a Whisper (and the rifle with the AP left: since rules 1.26 the rifle hits as hard in anyone's hands, and the Faith build's Dexterity sets the shape over the levels, hence the high end)
whisper_turn.dial: patrons.json the Whispers' values; rules.json output.profiles.blessing.k

hymn_turn.what: a turn with a Hymn (Old Overcast); Devotion 3 has Hymn I only, hence the low end at levels 1 to 5
hymn_turn.dial: patrons.json the Hymns' values; rules.json output.profiles.blessing.k

healer_turn.what: a healer's turn, all in, in Soldier-turns x 100 (rules 1.27, the heal re-fit: was 125; a normal share 160): the Soul healer's steady Buff heal; the Sigil healer's MEND line of 3 glyphs sits on the same ceiling through output.profiles.sigil_mend.k; a Hymn turn's healing is capped at hymn_heal_cap
healer_turn.dial: rules.json output.profiles.healing.k (and mend; sigil_mend, soul_mend and blessing_mend for their own systems)

shield.what: a shield is worth 1.2 times the heal of the same cost

weapon_art.what: not built: may break the ceiling as a charged ultimate, counted in the build's fight average (steady + 10%)

soldier_turn.note: what one Soldier of the fight's level takes off the plain rifleman in one of its turns (heal-shield-pass.md 1.1); one Soldier-turn kept off the squad counts as one plain rifle's turn of damage

control.note: a whole Soldier turn denied is worth one rifle-turn (100%); one AP off it a sixth of that; an Elite x1.4, a Boss x3 and never a whole turn; never the same enemy two rounds running (the Cut Short rule, for everything)

area.note: an area is worth its single-target allowance plus half of it for each extra target it is expected to catch; cluster: the enemies a shape catches when aimed at one of a standard group, measured (refit-measure.ts cluster: levels 1, 6, 12, open ground, rounds 2 on)

over_time.note: damage over time counts in full for 2 rounds, x0.75 for longer (the target dies or is cleansed)

cost.note: allowances on a ceiling for what the range leaves out (unified-damage proposal 2.6): no cost at all, a pool that empties over a session, a turn of set-up a target can waste, standing on what you prepared, standing in reach

tiers.note: the budget rule for one use: allowed = (AP / 6) x tier x (1 + cost allowances) x the area worth

output.rules: the unified damage formula, stage (a): a re-expression, no number moved (12 Nov 2026)
output.formula: amount = (base + flat) x Stat x Level x own multipliers x (1 + target bonuses, capped at +100%); dealt = max(1, floor(amount) - armour); healing and shields go to their sinks

level.note: One row a level, 1 to 20. deal (rules 1.26, the re-fit): what a character's level multiplies its damage by: the growth a Skill point used to carry, moved to level (Leon: skill buys accuracy, level buys damage); derived so that the normal-share plain rifle hits exactly as hard as before at every level (its old weapon multiplier divided by the weapon profile's k). mend: what it multiplies healing and shields by: the level row of the enemy table's damage column (rules 1.20), read from enemies.json, not copied here.

profiles.note: Stat = k x (1 + attr x (each Attribute of the pair - 1) + skill x each Skill of the pair). Rules 1.26 (the re-fit; Leon: no damage slope on rolled attacks, skill buys accuracy, level buys damage): every profile has one of three shapes. AIMED (an action that rolls to hit: a weapon, a Sigil Line, an Outburst): no slope, k a constant, the Level term deal. LANDED (an action that always lands: a prayer, a heal, a shield): 0.06 a point of Attribute over 1 and 0.06 a point of Skill (all in at 7/7 is 1.25 times a normal share at 4/4), k a constant. FLAT (what has no dealer's skill: a grenade, a tick, a trap a character sets): k 1, the Level term deal. Each k re-pins its system so that the normal share at level 1 is where it was (weapon 1.5, sigil 1.7, soul 1.55, healing 1.18, blessing 0.956). Rules 1.27 (the heal re-fit, Leon 12 Nov 2026): a healer's turn all in is 2.0 Soldier-turns (was 1.25), so the heal and shield profiles were scaled by 1.6 and trimmed to that ceiling: healing and mend, soul_mend (the Soul shields) and the Sigil boon's sigil_mend (a Sigil boon also multiplies by Healing given, so most of its rise came through healing); blessing_mend is the heal dial of a prayer (Blessing power times blessing_mend.k over blessing.k), capped where a Hymn turn heals 2.5 Soldier-turns at level 1. Each heal and shield profile has a floor: never under that share of a normal share's Stat term (output.floor_reference).

floor_reference.note: Rules 1.27 (the heal re-fit; spec item 1733): a landed heal or shield profile with a floor (output.profiles: healing, mend, sigil_mend, soul_mend, blessing_mend) never has a Stat term under floor x the Stat term of a normal share, which is this many points in each Attribute and Skill of its pair. A damage profile has no floor.

factors.note: Rules 1.26 (the re-fit): a system's own named multiplier where it has no number of its own to carry its identity. melee: every melee blow a character strikes (Leon, 12 Nov 2026: melee's all-in ceiling is 165% of the plain rifle, the gun's 145% plus the price of standing in reach). PROVISIONAL (spec item 1702)
factors.thrown_note: thrown: every grenade, thrown or placed charge a character sets off (frag, incendiary, satchel): on the measured cluster an area of radius 2 catches 2.8 enemies, and an area is allowed its single-target worth plus half for each extra target; a frag at 40 was 1.5 times that (spec item 1710). PROVISIONAL

weapon.from: weapons.json phys: each scales_with Attribute; the skill it hits with (also_scales when a weapon names it)

systems.note: Steps a4 and a5: each system's amount is its base x the Stat term x its own NAMED multipliers, every one a number in data; to re-fit a system, change the number where it lives. `where` names the field. `order`: the multipliers apply to the base one after another in this order; `round`: how the number is made whole.

sigil_damage.base: sigils.json items[word].damage (the strongest glyph in full, every other half; each damage type apart)
sigil_damage.stat: Sigil power: the Sigil multiplier, plus the Elemental bonus for Elemental damage (added)

own.shape: sigils.json: spread, chain, arc, twice, placed (a Burst's or a placed spell's multiplier on this creature)
own.line: sigils.json grammar.line_mult (by glyph count; a character's Lines)

sigil_boon.base: sigils.json items[mend].heal, items[ward].shield (heal_enemy, shield_enemy for an enemy caster)
sigil_boon.stat: the landed sigil_mend Stat (rules 1.26; the Sigil multiplier before)

own.healing given: the caster's Healing given (a second Stat term, as an own multiplier)

outburst_damage.base: soul_modules.json damage.base (damage.enemy_base for an enemy caster)
outburst_damage.round: none (harm floors it after the way of striking, a second school's half, the critical and the tone's riders)

own.stage: soul_modules.json cycle.stage_mult, plus feelings.json each feeling's step, the residue and resonance (added)

own.shape: schools[buff].area_mult in an area shape; items[split].boon_mult

prayer_damage.base: patrons.json: the prayer's stat_mod on hp (below 0), chain_damage, execute.boss_damage; an intervention's value + per_devotion x Devotion

prayer_mend.base: patrons.json: the prayer's heal or shield value; Mother Ember's intervention: its value + per_devotion x Devotion

own.heal dial: rules 1.27: output.profiles.blessing_mend.k over output.profiles.blessing.k (faith.ts mendDial); the intervention takes no level term

prayer_mend.round: round (a heal), none (a shield: its sink floors it)

kit.base: rules.json mending.medic (triage, stim, rally, field_repair_per_point x Improvisation)

magic_heal.base: what the spell or Outburst computed

amounts.note: Step a6: amount blocks that belong to no item (packages/engine/src/effects/amounts.ts, key rule:<name>). Every other block is on its item (`amounts`).

heal.text: the Buff school riding a shelved class's own strike (classes/soul.ts)

output.text: Every amount of damage, healing and shield is one formula with its terms in data (packages/engine/src/effects/output.ts): the source's base, the Stat term of its profile (the character's Attribute and Skill), the Level term, the source's own multipliers, then the bonuses against this target. The derived multipliers of the sheet (Physical, a weapon's, Sigil, Elemental, Soul, Healing given, Blessing power) are the Stat terms of these profiles, and the level factor of healing and shields is the mend column. Nothing is fitted by a number in code.

rolls.note: Read by packages/engine/src/rolls.ts, the one place the engine rolls a d20 (engine foundations 1, 12 Nov 2026). The save base TN is conditions_rules.save_base_tn and the check ladder is resolution.tn_ladder; what is here are the other numbers a roll used to carry as a literal.

forced_movement.note: Read by combat.ts displace(), the one function that moves a unit against its will (engine foundations 1, 12 Nov 2026; spec: Combat on the grid, Forced movement). For each kind of move: `tiles` is how the tiles are entered (each: tile by tile, and a trap, a field and a hazard act on every tile entered, a trap stopping the move there; landing: only the tile it ends on), `immunity` is whether Nailed, the knockback immunity and the forced_move hook can stop it, `reactions` is whether held Watches, Overwatch and opportunity attacks answer it (never: the mover did not choose to move). A move its own unit chose (`willing`) is never stopped by immunity.

break_not_persuade.resolved_as: a condition against a save: the speaker's strength with the skill that spoke against the target's save for that family

long.mp: full if meter band normal or richer

acquired.step: one perk step at each of Mastery 1 to 4: one of the skill's two perks at Tier I, or one already held raised to Tier II
acquired.mastered: the skill's own Mastered perk, granted automatically

achieved.requires: Mastery 2 (5 points) in every listed skill + a deed in play
achieved.granted_by: the engine for the nine deeds it can watch in a fight (rules 1.14); the Narrator for the other ten, and the Narrator may still grant any of them by hand

ultimate.granted: automatically when holding both named Achieved perks

engine_owns: voice passive checks and Ask-a-skill rolls
Echo totals and Overreach resist costs
narrator_owns: setting every TN and stating the stakes
writing voice hooks and voicing passed hooks
granting the Achieved perks whose deeds the engine cannot watch (it grants the nine fight deeds itself, rules 1.14; any may still be granted by hand) and recording deeds
setting the starting meter by location
keeping the Veil and the Knowing
Faith (rules 1.6): pacts, knowledge pieces, Narrator rites, Devotion XP moves for deeds (-6 to +5) and the day counter; the engine owns the tags, vows, Witnessed, interventions and the Miracles
trait and perk effects flagged narrator

veil.engine: record what is worn; apply nothing

equipment_slots.other_slots: each item lists its own small effects; none defined yet (spec 14 item 9)

ties.about: Classes 3.0 P8 (engine: kit.ts tie, untie, tiesOf): the kinds of tie between two units. A row: id, max (a holder's base cap; the stat ties_max:<kind> adds to it; no max: no cap), ends_on (from_down, to_down, to_dead, unseen_round, combat_end), on_end (none, or unmake: the far end is unmade, P9). Each system adds its own kind.

kinds.about: Classes 3.0 P9: an owned unit (owned.ts): its owner is the from end. The drone, the beast and the twin are tied so, for the whole fight; a system that needs more ends (an owner going Down, an unmake) adds its own kind.
